items.title: Tommy Newsom and Ross Tompkins interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, September 3, 1995
items.q: I’ve known Joe Williams so long that I don’t remember where I met him.

ctx.x: Joe was living in Vegas, he’d just come in, and half the time he’d sing a blues and we’d make up some riffs.

The two easiest people over the years that Doc Severinsen and I used to like to see, and this is going to sound ridiculous, were Ethel Merman and Joe Williams. They only did one take and heard the full run of it. They’d run it through once, that’s it. And that’s the only two people.
